flags.text: CRM's Meta ad-spend sync is 2 days old. Lead and booking counts above are live CRM data either way; only the CRM's own cost-per-lead view may lag until it's resynced.

CRM: 1 form fill in the 20 Nov 18:30 UTC to 21 Nov 18:30 UTC window (21 Nov 00:07 IST). It is a Meta-ad visitor (has_fbclid true, utm_source fb-ad, campaign 13Nov26 (b)), not a test. The contact has no other submission since 31 Oct, so it counts once. Meta's own count is 0 for now, so the CRM figure is the headline.
Bookings: no Appointment Booked record was created on 21 Nov (IST). The newest ones are dated 19 Nov and are not counted.

CRM Meta ad data last reported 19 Nov 2026 (get_ad_connection_health). That is two days behind today, so the CRM's own cost-per-lead may lag. Lead and booking counts are still live. Refresh in Lead Generation → Ad Launcher → Settings.

Campaign table: today's slice is ACTIVE-only and shows zero spend so far (both active campaigns). The month-to-date list was pulled with amount_spent > 0 and no status filter, so paused campaigns that spent this month stay listed. For the two active campaigns, last_active is 20 Nov, their most recent day with spend in the 20 Nov pull. For paused ones it is the updated_time date.
